evidence.quote: A positioning note used by the navigation/provenance regression guard.

observations.why: Flat descriptive assertion about the note's function — no hedges, no ratification language, no permanence markers; a stated position ready to defend but not performed as settled.

evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Aphoristic, identity-level distinction stated as bedrock with no hedging — the formulation itself ('is not the same as') treats the distinction as constitutive, and the document repeats it as creed in src-3 and src-4.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Creed-level restatement of the same constitutive distinction — 'the asset you keep' frames perspective as a permanent, identity-level value, not a moveable position; repetition of src-2's thesis as doctrine.

evidence.quote:
This restates the individually-owned-intelligence thesis so a navigating
extractor has existing positioning to connect to.

observations.why: Descriptive meta-commentary on the document's own purpose — asserted plainly but explanatory rather than creedal; the conviction is in the assertion's confidence, not in ratification or permanence language.

mints.name: AxiomaticDistinction
mints.title: a distinction stated as bedrock, not argued for
mints.frame: Is the position here performed as a self-evident axiom the speaker treats as constitutive, rather than as a claim requiring defense?
